stories.headline: 'I've applied for more than 400 roles' - how young people are facing the job shortage
stories.summary: The BBC has been hearing from young people who are struggling to find work about how they are tackling the challenge.

voices.student_north: Bhai 400 applications? Rookie numbers. Hamara placement cell mein jo ladka hai na, usne 600+ apply kiye. Still waiting for ek decent offer. At this rate uska CV hi apna LinkedIn profile ban jayega — har company ka "connection request" pending hoga.
voices.student_south: Bhai 400 applications matlab 400 rejections. I'm at 47 and already considering my professor's offer to be his TA for free. At least then somebody will remember my name when they're deciding who *not* to hire next.
voices.professional_north: Bhai 400 applications? Matlab ye log humse bhi zyada desperate hain. Humare yahan toh ek hi job hai aur usme 5 bosses hain jo same kaam ke liye alag alag target dete hain. Atleast ye log naye job search kar sakte hain — hum toh apne current wali se hi bhagne ki koshish kar rahe hain.
voices.professional_south: Bhai, 400 applications? That's cute. I've done 427 this quarter alone — boss ke liye. Every time company restructures, I apply for my own job like it's a fresh opening. At least those 400 people have hope. I'm just updating my LinkedIn bio to say "perpetually available for redundancy.

stories.summary: Albert  Manifold said no-one should be "allowed to hide behind anonymity" when commenting on his time at BP.

Atleast usko face-to-face ousting mila, hum toh email se hi terminate hone ke liye tayyar hain.

voices.professional_north: Yaar, ab tipping culture India mein bhi aa gaya. Pehle chai wale ko 2 rupees dete the, ab 20% chahiye. Aur haan, salary raise ke liye 10 saal wait karte ho, par waiter ko tip na do toh attitude badal jaata hai. Dono hi apna commission lena jaante hain.

stories.headline: Mint Explainer: Why India wants to go back to standard edible oil pack sizes

Mera confusion toh appraisal form dekh ke hi hota hai — same template, different numbers, kisi ko samajh nahi aata actual raise kitna hai. Government ko chahiye na ghar mein transparency, office mein toh woh luxury hai.
